raw:
The user wants UI strings in Traditional Chinese for an app that detected insufficient scratch/temporary computing space on the device, which may cause some features to slow down. Need: - s1: warning title - s2: warning body (one sentence) - s3: dismiss button Output only a JSON object with keys s1, s2, s3. Let me write: s1: "暫存空間不足" (Insufficient scratch space) s2: "偵測到裝置可用的暫存運算空間不足，部分功能可能會變慢。" — one sentence, mentions detection and slowdown. s3: "關閉" or "知道了" — dismiss button. "關閉" is standard for closing/dismissing. Make sure Traditional Chinese: 裝置, 偵測, 暫存, 部分 (Traditional: 部分 is fine; 部份 also used; use 部分), 變慢. Only JSON, no other text.```json { "s1": "暫存空間不足", "s2": "偵測到裝置可用的暫存運算空間不足，部分功能可能會變慢。", "s3": "關閉" } ```
（此訊息僅為說明，非 app 字串的一部分：以上即為所求的 JSON 物件。）
```json { "s1": "暫存空間不足", "s2": "偵測到裝置可用的暫存運算空間不足，部分功能可能會變慢。", "s3": "關閉" } ```
